newsitem.title: USA: Dollar General sets split, higher payout.
newsitem.headline: Dollar General sets split, higher payout.

text.p: Dollar General Corp said Monday directors declared a 5-for-4 stock split.

In conjunction with that action, the board maintained the quarterly cash dividend of $0.05 per share on all outstanding shares, thereby increasing the dividend income to its shareholders by 25 percent, the company said.
It said the split is payable February 17 to holders of record on February 3 with the distribution of one additional common share for each four shares now held.
Directors declared a quarterly dividend of $0.05 per share on the increased number of common shares outstanding after the split, payable March 10 to shareholders of record February 21.

The company noted this is the seventh 5-for-4 stock split in the last six years. After each split, Dollar General has maintained a cash dividend of $0.05 per share on all outstanding shares. ((-- New York Newsdesk 212-859-1610.))
